name: BOI Water Demand Prototype
short_description: Optional test module for Burden of Infrastructure: gives every household a wealth-based need for Local Water so the Waterworks have buyers.
patch_sensitivity_note: Replaces the whole of common/buy_packages/00_buy_packages.txt (99 keys, generated from vanilla by tools/Build-WaterPrototype.ps1). Regenerate after every game patch. INCOMPATIBLE with the housing prototype, which replaces the same file: use Build-WaterPrototype.ps1 -MergeIntoHousing and enable only the housing prototype instead.
